# Greywick Community Cinema: notes for the assistant advert

- The cinema is run by volunteers. The board has agreed to pay one part-time assistant, for the Friday and Saturday evenings. Doors open at 6 and the evening is over by about 10:30. The job is to welcome people, sell tickets and refreshments, start the film from the booth and lock up.
- Job title: Maeve, the manager, has not chosen between "Cinema Assistant" and "Projectionist". The two people who held the job before both said they called themselves assistants. The booth now has a digital projector that anyone can start from a tablet, and the last time a notice said "projectionist", three people asked if they would be threading film.
- Experience: Maeve has not decided whether the advert should ask for any. Both people before started with none. The board wrote that it would rather train someone from the town who wants the work than hire someone who has done it elsewhere.
- Pay: an hourly rate. The board sets it at its next meeting, and no date for that meeting is fixed. Nobody has said what the rate will be.
- Start: the new projector is being installed, and Maeve wants the new person to start the week it goes in, so they learn it from the first day. The supplier has not given an installation date, and nobody knows it.
- Applying: by email to `jobs@greywick-cinema.example`, with a short note about themselves. Maeve reads applications as they come in. There is no closing date.
